description: Retailer Dick’s Sporting Goods offers a wide selection of sporting goods equipment, fitness gear, golf products, fishing gear, apparel, footwear, and accessories. The company’s portfolio includes specialty concept stores such as Golf Galaxy, Public Lands, Going Going Gone!, and Dick’s House of Sport. Dick’s Sporting Goods was founded in 1948.

rankings.title: Fortune 500
rankings.itemDescription: The Pittsburgh-based retailer increased its revenues and its risks in 2025 by acquiring Foot Locker, the struggling sneaker seller. The $2.5 billion deal made Dick's one of the top distributors of brands like Nike and Adidas; efforts to turn around Foot Locker's underperforming stores have shown some promising signs this year.

rankings.title: Best Large Workplaces in Retail
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"The executive leadership present and perform as very normal individuals making themselves level with the entire team across the organization. This is how approachable and communicative they are to work with. That is exemplary in my opinion. There are zero barriers for any team member to ask questions, raise concerns, give suggestions, and work independently. This is the best place to work by far!"

rankings.title: Best Large Workplaces in Retail
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"The culture DSG is unlike any I've experienced before - welcoming, helpful, encouraging, positive - it really feels like I'm part of an actual sports team! There are plenty of opportunities, but no pressure, to join a multitude of groups from business-related to recreational sports. The total compensation package is generous and there are lots of other perks. I really appreciate the hybrid work schedule. Also, DSG gives back in spades to the communities we serve which I love!"

rankings.title: Fortune 500
rankings.itemDescription: Dick's Sporting Goods, the country's largest athletics and fitness retailer, moved up 42 spots on the Fortune 500 this year, powered by a solid 9.5% increase in sales in 2020. In the first quarter of 2021, Dick's beat analyst estimates, reporting net income of $361.8 million compared to a loss of $143.4 million a year ago.
